name: smwgraphics-popful-mail-snes-jungle-interior-wooden-forts
title: Popful Mail (SNES) - Jungle (Interior + Wooden Forts)
description:
The background seen the player is deep in the Jungle, from the Super Famicom version of Popful Mail. Since the original background was quite tricky to rip, I edited to look more user friendly and manageable. A good fit for jungle levels.

UPDATE: Now it includes a version without the jungle forts, for people who only want to use the jungle portion of the background.

Credit would be great, but it is optional.
